readmeExcerpt:
> [!WARNING] > **Reasonix is no longer maintained as of 2026-11-12.** The final release is v2.61.0; there will be no further releases, fixes or issue triage. The project is MIT-licensed and forks are welcome. See the [announcement](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/issues/15109).

English  ·  简体中文  ·  Guide  ·  ACP  ·  Extensions  ·  Spec  ·  Website


Open source · MIT · runs on your computer, model of your choice

An open-source coding agent for your terminal, desktop, browser and editor.

It reads your project, edits files and runs commands and tests. Have it ask before each step, or work on its own within limits you set. Files its edit tools changed can be rewound. New here? Start with the Studio desktop app.

Maintained by Huahui Yu.


## What it is Reasonix is an open-source AI coding assistant. The program runs on your computer; the AI model is a service you configure, which receives what it reads. You describe a task in plain language; it reads code, edits files and runs commands and tests inside the project folder you choose, and shows you each step. You pick the model: a DeepSeek preset is built in, any OpenAI-compatible service is one config entry, and you pay the model provider directly. ## What you get - **Read, edit, run.** It reads code, edits files and runs tests and commands, all inside your project folder. - **Permission levels.** Have it ask every time, or let everyday actions run on their own; your forbid rules always hold. To see the approach first, use plan mode: it starts work only once you approve. - **Rewind.** A file is saved before it changes, so you can rewind by conversation turn without touching your git history. Only files its edit tools changed are covered, not what a shell command did. ## 30-second start Download, add a model key, open a project. New here? Start with the Studio desktop app. 1. Download and install the desktop app, Reasonix Studio, from the [releases page](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true). 2. Open it and enter your model provider and key when asked. 3. Open your project folder and write what you want, for example "add retry on failure to the http client". 4. At the level you chose, it stops and asks before anything that needs your say-so. Allow it to continue, or refuse. Prefer a terminal? Download the `reasonix` command-line tool, run `reasonix setup` to pick a model, then run `reasonix`. See [Install](#install) and [Quick start](#quick-start). ## Four ways to use it - **Desktop app (Studio).** A graphical app; the best place to start. - **Terminal.** A full-screen text interface; `reasonix run "task"` also works in scripts. - **Browser.** `reasonix web` opens a web interface on your own machine. - **Editor.** Install the extension in VS Code; other editors that support ACP (Agent Client Protocol, a common way for an editor to connect to an AI assistant) can connect to `reasonix acp`. All four are the same program underneath. What follows is for advanced users and contributors. ## Use it from DeepSeek Harness DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) can hand a task to Reasonix as a subagent over ACP. This repository publishes a plugin index for it: 1. Run `reasonix setup` on the machine that runs `dsh`. In the DSH Web UI turn on Custom plugin markets (Plugins, More) and add this index in the Discover tab: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/studio/integrations/dsh-plugin/market-index.json` 2. Install "Reasonix subagent" from it. 3. Open the plugin's page and turn its switch on. While it is off the model has no `reasonix` tool and may run `reasonix -p` in its own shell, which looks like a delegation and is not one. Setup details, the permission policy and limits are in [Using Reasonix from DeepSeek Harness](./docs/DSH.md). ## Versions Reasonix ships on two lines. See the [version roadmap announcement](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/discussions/10748) for the reasoning behind the split. | Line | Branch | Status | Get it | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Reasonix 2.x** | `studio` (this branch) | Active development | [Studio releases](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true) | | **Reasonix 1.x** | [`main-v2`](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/tree/main-v2) | Maintenance / stable | `npm i -g reasonix` · [desktop download](https://reasonix.io/?download=desktop#start) | - **Want something stable?** Stay on 1.x. It keeps receiving bug fixes, provider/API compatibility, updater and security fixes; its core architecture is no longer being extended. - **Want the new architecture?** Use 2.x Reasonix Studio. It is still moving quickly; reports are welcome. Valuable fixes, tests and behaviour from 1.x are reviewed one by one and ported or reimplemented on 2.x where they fit the new architecture. - [Moving from 1.x to 2.x](./docs/MIGRATING.md): what the two lines share, and how to run both on one machine without losing sessions. - [2.x roadmap](./docs/ROADMAP.md): what 2.x still has to deliver, how it ships, and the decisions still open. ## Features Technical highlights for advanced users. - **Config-driven.** Providers, the agent, enabled tools, and plugins are all declared in `reasonix.toml`. No hardcoded models. - **Multi-model & composable.** DeepSeek ships as a preset; any OpenAI-compatible endpoint is a config entry, not new code. Optionally run two models together (executor + planner) in separate, cache-stable sessions. - **Plugin-driven.** MCP servers contribute tools, prompts, and resources; Extension Protocol v1 sidecars can also intercept runtime events, contribute Providers and structured UI, and ship versioned plugin packages. - **Cache-aware context maintenance.** Startup injects a small stable environment summary, stale tool output is snipped/pruned before summary compaction, and the built-in tool schema contract is documented for regression review. - **Zero-friction distribution.** `CGO_ENABLED=0` single binary; cross-compile to six targets with one command. The result is a fully self-contained static binary — nothing to install on the target machine beyond the binary itself. ## Install This branch is **Reasonix 2.x**. Its desktop app is Reasonix Studio; the CLI, Studio, and editor integrations all run the same local Reasonix engine. ### Reasonix Studio (2.x) Download the package for your platform from the latest [Studio release](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true) (tagged `studio-v2.*`; candidates such as `-rc.N` are marked as pre-releases): | Platform | Package | Architecture | | --- | --- | --- | | macOS | `.dmg` or `.zip` | Apple Silicon (`arm64`) / Intel (`amd64`) | | Windows | Installer `-installer.exe` or portable `.zip` | x64 | | Linux | `.deb`, `.rpm`, or `.AppImage` (download only) | x64 (`amd64`) / ARM64 (`arm64`, aarch64) | Every package ships with a `.minisig` signature, and the release carries `SHA256SUMS`. Once installed, Studio updates itself in place. The same release also carries the 2.x `reasonix` CLI as archives for `darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64`. ### Reasonix 1.x (stable) The 1.x CLI installs through npm on any supported platform, or Homebrew on macOS: ```sh npm i -g reasonix # any OS; pulls the prebuilt native binary brew install esengine/reasonix/reasonix # macOS ``` The 1.x desktop app is on the [official download page](https://reasonix.io/?download=desktop#start). Windows installers are code-signed with a Certum code-signing certificate. ### VS Code extension The extension does not bundle the CLI; it starts your local `reasonix acp` backend and adds native chat, editor context, tool-call approvals, model selection, and workspace sessions. Install the 1.x CLI first. - **VS Code:** [install from Visual Studio Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=SivanLiu.reasonix-agent) - **VSCodium / Eclipse Theia:** [install from Open VSX Registry](https://open-vsx.org/extension/SivanLiu/reasonix-agent) - **Extension ID:** `SivanLiu.reasonix-agent` · [source and usage guide](https://github.com/SivanCola/reasonix-vscode) ### Build from source Clone the repository; `studio` builds 2.x and `main-v2` builds 1.x: ```sh git clone https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix.git cd DeepSeek-Reasonix git switch studio ``` #### CLI The CLI build requires **Go 1.25+**. The module pins a `toolchain` directive; keep `GOTOOLCHAIN=auto` so Go downloads the pinned toolchain, or install it. ```sh make build # -> bin/reasonix(.exe) make cross # -> dist/ (darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64) ``` #### Studio Studio additionally requires **Node 24+ and pnpm 10** (`npm install -g pnpm@10`) for the frontend. ```sh make studio ``` See the [Studio build guide](desktop/README.md#prerequis

Warning

Reasonix is no longer maintained as of 2026-11-12. The final release is v2.61.0; there will be no further releases, fixes or issue triage. The project is MIT-licensed and forks are welcome. See the announcement.

English  ·  简体中文  ·  Guide  ·  ACP  ·  Extensions  ·  Spec  ·  Website


Open source · MIT · runs on your computer, model of your choice

An open-source coding agent for your terminal, desktop, browser and editor.

It reads your project, edits files and runs commands and tests. Have it ask before each step, or work on its own within limits you set. Files its edit tools changed can be rewound. New here? Start with the Studio desktop app.

Maintained by Huahui Yu.


What it is

Reasonix is an open-source AI coding assistant. The program runs on your computer; the AI model is a service you configure, which receives what it reads. You describe a task in plain language; it reads code, edits files and runs commands and tests inside the project folder you choose, and shows you each step.

You pick the model: a DeepSeek preset is built in, any OpenAI-compatible service is one config entry, and you pay the model provider directly.

What you get

  • Read, edit, run. It reads code, edits files and runs tests and commands, all inside your project folder.
  • Permission levels. Have it ask every time, or let everyday actions run on their own; your forbid rules always hold. To see the approach first, use plan mode: it starts work only once you approve.
  • Rewind. A file is saved before it changes, so you can rewind by conversation turn without touching your git history. Only files its edit tools changed are covered, not what a shell command did.

30-second start

Download, add a model key, open a project. New here? Start with the Studio desktop app.

  1. Download and install the desktop app, Reasonix Studio, from the releases page.
  2. Open it and enter your model provider and key when asked.
  3. Open your project folder and write what you want, for example "add retry on failure to the http client".
  4. At the level you chose, it stops and asks before anything that needs your say-so. Allow it to continue, or refuse.

Prefer a terminal? Download the reasonix command-line tool, run reasonix setup to pick a model, then run reasonix. See Install and Quick start.

Four ways to use it

  • Desktop app (Studio). A graphical app; the best place to start.
  • Terminal. A full-screen text interface; reasonix run "task" also works in scripts.
  • Browser. reasonix web opens a web interface on your own machine.
  • Editor. Install the extension in VS Code; other editors that support ACP (Agent Client Protocol, a common way for an editor to connect to an AI assistant) can connect to reasonix acp.

All four are the same program underneath. What follows is for advanced users and contributors.

Use it from DeepSeek Harness

DeepSeek Harness (dsh) can hand a task to Reasonix as a subagent over ACP. This repository publishes a plugin index for it:

  1. Run reasonix setup on the machine that runs dsh. In the DSH Web UI turn on Custom plugin markets (Plugins, More) and add this index in the Discover tab: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/studio/integrations/dsh-plugin/market-index.json
  2. Install "Reasonix subagent" from it.
  3. Open the plugin's page and turn its switch on. While it is off the model has no reasonix tool and may run reasonix -p in its own shell, which looks like a delegation and is not one.

Setup details, the permission policy and limits are in Using Reasonix from DeepSeek Harness.

Versions

Reasonix ships on two lines. See the version roadmap announcement for the reasoning behind the split.

Line Branch Status Get it
Reasonix 2.x studio (this branch) Active development Studio releases
Reasonix 1.x main-v2 Maintenance / stable npm i -g reasonix · desktop download
  • Want something stable? Stay on 1.x. It keeps receiving bug fixes, provider/API compatibility, updater and security fixes; its core architecture is no longer being extended.
  • Want the new architecture? Use 2.x Reasonix Studio. It is still moving quickly; reports are welcome.

Valuable fixes, tests and behaviour from 1.x are reviewed one by one and ported or reimplemented on 2.x where they fit the new architecture.

  • Moving from 1.x to 2.x: what the two lines share, and how to run both on one machine without losing sessions.
  • 2.x roadmap: what 2.x still has to deliver, how it ships, and the decisions still open.

Features

Technical highlights for advanced users.

  • Config-driven. Providers, the agent, enabled tools, and plugins are all declared in reasonix.toml. No hardcoded models.
  • Multi-model & composable. DeepSeek ships as a preset; any OpenAI-compatible endpoint is a config entry, not new code. Optionally run two models together (executor + planner) in separate, cache-stable sessions.
  • Plugin-driven. MCP servers contribute tools, prompts, and resources; Extension Protocol v1 sidecars can also intercept runtime events, contribute Providers and structured UI, and ship versioned plugin packages.
  • Cache-aware context maintenance. Startup injects a small stable environment summary, stale tool output is snipped/pruned before summary compaction, and the built-in tool schema contract is documented for regression review.
  • Zero-friction distribution. CGO_ENABLED=0 single binary; cross-compile to six targets with one command. The result is a fully self-contained static binary — nothing to install on the target machine beyond the binary itself.

Install

This branch is Reasonix 2.x. Its desktop app is Reasonix Studio; the CLI, Studio, and editor integrations all run the same local Reasonix engine.

Reasonix Studio (2.x)

Download the package for your platform from the latest Studio release (tagged studio-v2.*; candidates such as -rc.N are marked as pre-releases):

Platform Package Architecture
macOS .dmg or .zip Apple Silicon (arm64) / Intel (amd64)
Windows Installer -installer.exe or portable .zip x64
Linux .deb, .rpm, or .AppImage (download only) x64 (amd64) / ARM64 (arm64, aarch64)

Every package ships with a .minisig signature, and the release carries SHA256SUMS. Once installed, Studio updates itself in place.

The same release also carries the 2.x reasonix CLI as archives for darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64.

Reasonix 1.x (stable)

The 1.x CLI installs through npm on any supported platform, or Homebrew on macOS:

npm i -g reasonix                  # any OS; pulls the prebuilt native binary
brew install esengine/reasonix/reasonix   # macOS

The 1.x desktop app is on the official download page. Windows installers are code-signed with a Certum code-signing certificate.

VS Code extension

The extension does not bundle the CLI; it starts your local reasonix acp backend and adds native chat, editor context, tool-call approvals, model selection, and workspace sessions. Install the 1.x CLI first.

  • VS Code: install from Visual Studio Marketplace
  • VSCodium / Eclipse Theia: install from Open VSX Registry
  • Extension ID: SivanLiu.reasonix-agent · source and usage guide

Build from source

Clone the repository; studio builds 2.x and main-v2 builds 1.x:

git clone https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix.git
cd DeepSeek-Reasonix
git switch studio

CLI

The CLI build requires Go 1.25+. The module pins a toolchain directive; keep GOTOOLCHAIN=auto so Go downloads the pinned toolchain, or install it.

make build      # -> bin/reasonix(.exe)
make cross      # -> dist/ (darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64)

Studio

Studio additionally requires Node 24+ and pnpm 10 (npm install -g pnpm@10) for the frontend.

make studio

See the Studio build guide for platform webview dependencies and Linux build tags.

Quick start

Reasonix Studio

Install and launch Studio, then connect a provider and model in the app. No CLI setup is needed.

CLI / TUI

reasonix setup                      # configure a provider and model
reasonix                            # start an interactive session
reasonix run "implement the TODOs in main.go"

In an interactive session, run /init when you want Reasonix to create project instructions.

For advanced CLI usage and configuration, see the CLI reference, Guide, and configuration paths.

Documentation

  • Getting started: Guide · CLI reference · Configuration paths · ACP editor integration · Use from DeepSeek Harness
  • Features & troubleshooting: Subagent profiles · Context Engine v2 · Capability diagnostics · Recovery and updates · Checkpoints & rewind
  • Agent presets: Session Agent compositions
  • Engineering & migration: Spec · Task contracts & pause policy · Tool contract · Moving from 1.x to 2.x · 2.x roadmap
  • Extension development: Skills · Extensions · Plugin packages and Manifest v1 · Extension Protocol · Go SDK and starter

Star History


Acknowledgments

A small list of folks whose work has shaped Reasonix the most — the current top 20 contributors by commit count. The full contributor graph is on GitHub.

Contributor Contributor Contributor Contributor
SivanCola KHG420 ttmouse chuiwenwei
lifu963 XTLine HUQIANTAO xxoingr

light-front-theory imcreazy eghrhegpe noreply

Special thanks to Bernardxu123 for designing the project logo and intro video.

releases.name: Reasonix Studio v2.61.0
releases.body:
本版是最后一个版本：移除软件内的反馈建议、崩溃报告上传和匿名统计，并修复文件树、提交历史等一批问题。

## 新增

- 工作台的文件树可以拖动边缘调整宽度，宽度会被记住，双击边缘恢复默认 (376376843)
- 新增「进程」按钮，点开列出本会话正在运行的后台任务和子智能体 (3807e411d)
- 新增设置「允许模型直接打开工作区内的文件夹」，默认关闭；打开后模型把本工作区内的文件夹加入项目时不再弹批准卡 #15090

## 修复

- 公式不再被裁掉上标的顶部 #15092
- 没有伪控制台的 Windows 上，终端会说明原因，而不是报"shell 启动失败" #15091
- 在 Cygwin 或 MSYS 终端里运行时，会提示界面无法在这里运行以及该怎么办 #15091
- Windows 上安装前端依赖（pnpm install）不再失败 #15067
- 操作被拒绝时的原因不再被输入框盖住 (f4b815ecd)
- 读取内核失败时，窗口会说明内核无法连接以及是哪一次读取，而不是只显示"Failed to fetch" #15070
- 窄栏里「更改」标题行的按钮换行显示，不再挤成竖排并出现横向滚动条 (a717dcd34)
- 提交历史会在新提交出现、分支变化时自动刷新 (803583e4a)
- 选了资源管理器后，右边不再留着已经打开的启动菜单 (0a17f7774)
- 归档长会话时不再逐个规范化其他会话的路径，归档明显更快 (5cd38fde8)
- Homebrew 安装不再因为 cask 无法读取而失败 #15071
- 构建改用 Go 1.26.11，修复标准库 net/http 的已知漏洞 GO-2026-6859 (75f560400)

## 移除

- 移除软件内的反馈与建议入口、崩溃报告上传和匿名统计；项目不再维护 (21ffa334b)

## 升级须知

- 本版之后项目不再维护。软件不会再向维护者发送任何报告或统计，`reasonix report send` 会被拒绝；更新检查和扩展市场仍会访问原有服务，服务停止后将不可用 (21ffa334b)

---

<!-- lang:en -->

This is the last release: it removes the in-app feedback, crash report upload and anonymous statistics, and fixes a batch of issues in the file tree, commit history and more.

releases.name: Reasonix Studio v2.60.0
releases.body:
本版让内置浏览器可以点选页面元素并把修改直接存回本地网页，会话之间的消息不再需要批准，工作台可并排显示文件树。

## 新增

- 内置浏览器新增「点选页面元素」：点一下页面上的元素，就能看到它的选择器、文字和颜色 (6c9c6851a)
- 从工作区本地文件打开的网页，可以直接改所选元素的文字、文字颜色、背景色和字号，并保存回文件；文件源码里对不上的元素会说明原因，不会写入 (6c9c6851a)
- 工作台在打开的文件旁边显示文件树 (2ff95dbc5)

## 变更

- 「让模型把任务交给其他会话」开关打开时（默认开启），你自己的其他会话发来的消息直接交给模型，不再出现批准卡；关闭开关则仍需批准 (4dc2b1938)
- 保存会话时不再为每条消息复制一份数据，长会话的保存更快、占用更少内存 (e19fc12a5)

## 升级须知

- 会话间消息默认不再需要批准：同机其他会话写进消息目录的内容，会在开关打开时直接进入模型；不想要请在设置的「会话间消息」里关闭派发开关 (4dc2b1938)

---

<!-- lang:en -->

## New

- The built-in browser can pick an element on the page: click it to see its selector, text and colors (6c9c6851a)
- On a page opened from a workspace file, the picked element's text, text color, background and size can be changed and saved back to the file; an element the file's source cannot place is refused with the reason and nothing is written (6c9c6851a)
- The workbench shows the file tree beside the open file (2ff95dbc5)

## Changed

- While the switch that lets the model hand tasks to other sessions is on (the default), a message from your other sessions reaches the model without an approval card; with the switch off it still waits for approval (4dc2b1938)

aiSummary.oneLiner: An optimized reasoning engine designed to enhance the analytical capabilities of DeepSeek models.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: DeepSeek-Reasonix is a specialized framework that significantly boosts the complex problem-solving abilities of DeepSeek language models. It addresses the limitations of standard inference by implementing advanced prompting strategies and multi-step reasoning architectures directly into the execution pipeline. The technical approach involves breaking down intricate queries into smaller, verifiable sub-tasks and utilizing self-reflection loops to correct errors before generating the final output. What sets this apart is its specific tuning for the DeepSeek model family, extracting maximum performance for logic, math, and coding tasks without requiring massive computational overhead. It transforms a standard LLM into a highly deliberate reasoning engine.
keyFeatures: Multi-Step Decomposition: Automatically breaks complex problems into manageable sub-tasks for more accurate processing.
Self-Correction Loops: Implements built-in reflection mechanisms where the model critiques and refines its own intermediate answers.
DeepSeek Optimization: Specifically tuned to leverage the unique architectural traits and training distribution of DeepSeek models.
Traceable Logic Paths: Outputs the intermediate reasoning steps, providing transparency into how the final answer was derived.
Lightweight Integration: Provides a clean API that can be easily dropped into existing inference pipelines without heavy dependencies.

useCases.title: Complex Mathematical Solving
useCases.description: Researchers use the engine to tackle advanced math problems where standard one-shot prompting frequently fails.

useCases.title: Algorithmic Code Generation
useCases.description: Software developers deploy it to generate highly optimized algorithms by forcing the model to plan the logic before writing syntax.

useCases.title: Legal Document Analysis
useCases.description: Analysts utilize the traceable reasoning paths to verify the logic used when extracting clauses from dense legal contracts.

useCases.title: Automated QA Verification
useCases.description: QA teams integrate the self-correction loops to build more reliable automated testing scripts that adapt to dynamic UI changes.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This framework is targeted at AI researchers, developers, and data scientists who require high-reliability outputs for complex logical tasks. It requires familiarity with LLM prompting techniques and basic Python integration.
